title: Epic-state golden pins 'needs you: nothing' beside a held tick
body:
epicStateFixture hand-builds Attention: [] next to a needs-person wait, so watch_dashboard_epic_state.txt pins the very output property P2 forbids; Build on the same story (build_epic_test.go:321-335) yields an attention entry. Render the epic-state golden from Build's output.
evidence: internal/cli/watch_epic_state_test.go; internal/cli/testdata/watch_dashboard_epic_state.txt; internal/statusmodel/build_epic_test.go:321-335
